verdict.rationale: A search API could plausibly offer scheduled queries or monitoring alerts, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party scheduling, recurring jobs or background automation. The n8n, Dify and OpenClaw guides describe third-party host platforms that call the API, and the Answers 'deep research' mode is a one-off streamed request, not a recurring background schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
